blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 43 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 6, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & HPE lead 43 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 26 Canadian and 17 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 6, 2026) found 43 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 26 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 14 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +134% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 12 names.

In the U.S., 17 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 6 of them new to the list this week. Hewlett Packard Enterprise Company (HPE) leads with a +187% six-month return, and Information Technology is the most represented sector with 12 names.
